# senv

> senv is a Rust library for writing reinforcement-learning environments as h5i-app kernels and serving them to unmodified OpenEnv clients over the OpenEnv WebSocket protocol. The kernel is a pure h5i-app `Kernel` that decides rewards and termination; `senv::Environment` is the shell that parses OpenEnv requests and renders observations. Each session runs on its own h5i-app MemoryEngine.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://senv.h5i.dev/): what the library is.
- [Manual](https://senv.h5i.dev/manual/): the `Environment` trait, serve flags, the Python clients, limits.
- [README](https://github.com/h5i-dev/senv/blob/main/README.md): a complete environment in two crates.
- [Protocol](https://github.com/h5i-dev/senv/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md): the supported OpenEnv subset.
- [Design](https://github.com/h5i-dev/senv/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md): kernel, shell, sessions, and what a kernel proof covers.
- [Notice](https://github.com/h5i-dev/senv/blob/main/NOTICE): Apache-2.0 for senv and h5i-app; BSD-3-Clause for the OpenEnv behavior this library follows.

## Pins

- OpenEnv: `58d0344011fe961342706c90288f7e842b15b1c9` (openenv/OpenEnv).
- h5i-app: `0.5.5` (crates.io).

## API

- `senv::Environment`: `metadata`, `principal`, `reset`, `step`, `state`, `observe`, `render_state`, `refuse`; optional `schema`, `initial`, `tools`, `call_tool`, `tool_result`. `type Kernel: h5i_app::Kernel`.
- `senv::run(env, ServeArgs)`: serve with `--bind`, `--max-sessions`, `--max-message-bytes`, `--idle-timeout-secs`.
- `senv::Server::new(env, ServerConfig)`: `router()`, `serve(listener)`, `spawn(addr)` for tests.
- `senv::Session::open(Arc<env>, episode_id)`: in-process `reset`, `step`, `state`, `call_tool`, `snapshot`.

## Examples

- `examples/echo` (`cargo run -p echo-env`): the OpenEnv Echo MCP environment for the `EchoEnv` client.
- `examples/wordle` (`cargo run -p wordle-env`): Wordle-v0 for `TextArenaEnv`, with its kernel proved in `examples/wordle/proofs`.
- `examples/arith` (`cargo run -p arith-env -- --ops 3`): Arith-v0, a multi-turn calculator task for `TextArenaEnv`. The value is never in the observation or `state()`.

## Behavior that callers hit

- A WebSocket disconnect destroys that session. The official client ignores the following `session/close` error.
- Default cap is 8 sessions. Default max WebSocket message is 16 MiB. Unattached sessions idle out after 120 seconds.
- There is no `/reset`, `/step`, or `/state` HTTP API, no CORS, and no Gradio UI.
